name: Inspirational Performance
body:
Your bardic performances now include a minor boost that inspires your allies to success on certain actions.

Prerequisite(s): BAB +3, bardic performance, and 3 skill ranks in any Perform skill.

Benefit: Each round in which you spend at least one round of bardic performance to maintain an ongoing bardic performance you created with an audible component that affects at least one creature other than yourself, you may select 1 target creature within range of your bardic performance other than yourself. If you succeed on a Perform check (DC 20), that target creature gains the benefits of the aid another action as if you succeeded on an aid another check.

Special: The effects of this feat do not trigger during any round in which your bardic performance required no rounds of bardic performance to maintain (such as through a tuned bowstring or Lingering Performance).

The effects of this feat also do not trigger during a bardic performance you created through the use of spells or magic items.
